title: Two dead, three missing in separate drowning incidents
byline: Three brothers who went to bathe in the Mahaweli River, which flows through the Somawathiya Reserve in Serunuwara, have drowned and gone missing.

title: Trump hints Iran talks could resume this week as US maritime blockade continues
byline: President Donald Trump has suggested talks aimed at ending the war in Iran could resume this week, after negotiations collapsed at the weekend, prompting the US to blockade Iranian ports.

title: Donald Trump believes Iran war will end soon
byline: President Donald Trump said the war with Iran is “close to over”, according to remarks from an interview with Maria Bartiromo set to air on Fox News.

title: State oil-anointing ceremony for New Year to be held today
byline: The official state ceremony for the traditional oil-anointing ritual of the Sinhala and Tamil New Year is scheduled to take place this morning (April 15) at the premises of the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic in Kandy.

title: Anointing of oil ritual for New Year begins
byline: The auspicious time for the tradition of anointing oil for the Sinhala and Tamil New Year commenced at 6:55 a.m. today (15).

title: Showers expected in several provinces after 1pm
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Southern, and North-western provinces, and in Anuradhapura district after 1.00 pm.

title: President participates in New Year oil anointing ceremony in Kandy
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake participates in the New Year oil anointing ceremony in Kandy.

title: Lebanon and Israel agree to hold more talks after first direct negotiations in over three decades
byline: Israel and Lebanon have agreed to meet again, officials said, after a first round of talks were held Tuesday in Washington, DC.

title: 250 Rohingya and Bangladeshis missing after migrant boat sinks in Andaman Sea
byline: About 250 Rohingya and Bangladeshis, including children, are missing after their boat capsized last week in the Andaman Sea, according to the United Nations’ refugee and migration agencies.

title: Additional buses and trains to be deployed for those returning to Colombo
byline: Based on the needs of passengers who travelled to their hometowns for the Sinhala and Tamil New Year, steps have been taken to deploy additional buses to Colombo starting today (15), the National Transport Commission (NTC) has announced.

title: Man and woman killed in separate incidents; Unidentified body recovered in Anuradhapura
byline: Two murders have been reported in Wellawaya and Payagala resulting in the deaths of a woman and a man, while another unidentified male body has also been recovered, police said.

title: Government offices to remain open April 15–17; Bus and train services resume after New Year holidays
byline: Government offices across the country will remain open as usual on April 15, 16, and 17, the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government has announced.

title: US set to launch tariff refund system on April 20
byline: US President Donald Trump’s administration plans to launch next Monday the system it will use for issuing refunds to American importers for $166 billion the companies paid in tariffs that the U.S. Supreme Court struck down in February as unlawful.

title: Trump again hits out at Pope Leo and NATO in flurry of Truth Social posts
byline: Donald Trump has once again hit out at Pope Leo and NATO in a series of Truth Social posts.

title: Showers expected in several provinces after 1pm today
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Southern, and North-western provinces and in the Anuradhapura district after 1.00 p.m. today (15), the Department of Meteorology stated.

title: No breakthrough during historic talks between Lebanon and Israel
byline: Lebanon and Israel held their first direct diplomatic talks in decades on Tuesday in Washington following more than a month of war between Israel and the Iran-backed Hezbollah militant group, with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio calling it a “historic opportunity” but making clear that no breakthrough agreement would happen right away.

title: US destroyer interdicts two oil tankers attempting to leave Iran, official says
byline: A U.S. destroyer interdicted two oil tankers attempting to leave Iran on Tuesday, a day after U.S. President Donald Trump’s blockade went into effect, and instructed them to turn around, a U.S. official said, speaking on condition of anonymity.

title: Oil prices fall for a second day on expectations US-Iran talks may resume
byline: Oil prices fell for a second day on Wednesday on expectations peace talks between the US and Iran may resume and eventually release supply from the key Middle East producing region trapped by the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

title: One dead, three family members injured in Buttala accident
byline: An individual died while three of his family members sustained injuries following a fatal road accident reported on the Wellawaya–Monaragala main road in Buttala, early this morning (15), police stated.

title: President engages in religious observances in Kandy
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake today (15) visited the historic Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, engaged in religious observances and received blessings for the Sinhala and Tamil New Year.

title: AI chatbots give misleading medical advice 50% of the time, study finds
byline: Artificial intelligence-driven chatbots are giving users problematic medical advice about half the time, according to a new study, highlighting the health risks of the technology that is becoming increasingly integral in day-to-day life.

title: Justin Bieber breaks all Coachella records with headline performance
byline: Global superstar Justin Bieber is once again proving his cultural impact extends far beyond the stage.

title: US will not renew 30-day waiver on Iranian oil
byline: The US will not renew a 30-day waiver of sanctions on Iranian oil at sea that expires this week, and quietly let a similar waiver on sanctions on Russian oil expire over the weekend, two administration officials told Reuters on Tuesday, as the U.S. imposes a blockade on shipments from Iranian ports.

title: Gold prices in Sri Lanka rise by around Rs. 4,000
byline: Gold prices in Sri Lanka have increased by around Rs. 4,000, Local market data indicates.

title: Advisory issued for severe lightning
byline: An ‘Amber’ advisory has been issued by the Department of Meteorology for severe lightning in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, and Uva provinces, as well as in the Galle, Matara, Anuradhapura, and Kurunegala districts.

title: Russia renews offer to receive Iran’s enriched uranium
byline: Russia has renewed an offer to “resolve the issue of Iran’s enriched uranium stockpiles”, as speculation mounts of a fresh round of US-Iran peace talks in the coming days, state media reported on Wednesday.

title: SLTB generates Rs. 1 bln revenue during New Year festive period
byline: The Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB) generated an income of Rs. 1 billion within six days by providing special services during the Sinhala and Tamil New Year season, according to its Chairman, Sajeewa Kanakarathna.

title: Pakistan Navy ships TAIMUR and ASLAT conclude goodwill visit
byline: The Pakistan Navy Ship (PNS) TAIMUR and ASLAT departed the island, following a two-day goodwill visit, the Sri Lanka Navy said.

title: Congestion reported near expressway toll gates after New Year holidays
byline: Long queues of vehicles were reportedly observed today (15) at the Pinnaduwa entrance of the Southern Expressway in Galle.

title: Japan to provide $10 billion to Southeast Asia to ease oil price strain
byline: Japan has decided to provide a total of $10 billion in financial support to Southeast Asian nations struggling with surging crude oil prices amid tensions in the Middle East, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi announced during an online meeting with Southeast Asian leaders on Wednesday.

title: Week-long water wastage reported in Meegoda after burst pipeline
byline: Residents of the Udagewatta Road area in Meegoda say that a major water leak caused by a burst pipeline has been persisting for over a week, leading to considerable water wastage.

title: Fisherman killed, another injured in mid-sea boat collision off Mannar
byline: A fisherman has reportedly died after two fishing boats collided and capsized in the sea area off Mannar.

title: 36 road accidents and 35 assault cases reported to National Hospital over New Year period
byline: A total of 36 road traffic accidents have been reported to the Colombo National Hospital during the New Year period on April 13 and 14, hospital sources said.

title: Any attempts to force Iran to surrender are destined to fail: Iranian President
byline: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian says any attempts by the US or Israel to force Iran to “surrender” are “destined to fail and the Iranian nation will never accept such an approach."

title: Fuel prices will go down ‘tremendously’ once war is settled, says Trump
byline: US President Donald Trump says in an interview on Fox Business Network, that if you give Iran a nuclear weapon, ‘‘the world will be blown up."

title: Iran war escalation could push global economy to brink of recession, IMF warns
byline: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) warned that a further escalation in the war on Iran and continued disruption to oil markets could push the global economy to the brink of recession, with growth potentially slowing to 2% under its worst-case scenario.

title: FSP claims unusual release of Victoria Reservoir’s water for electricity generation
byline: The Frontline Socialist Party (FSP) alleges that the government has decided to release water from the Victoria Reservoir in an unusual manner for electricity generation.

title: Two bodies recovered after drowning incident in Mahaweli River
byline: Two bodies have been recovered this afternoon (15) near the Verugal Aru Bridge on the Mahaweli River, where a father and his four sons were swept away while bathing.

title: President meets Mahanayaka Thero of Sri Lanka Ramanna Nikaya
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has called on the Most Venerable Aggamaha Pandita Makulewe Wimala Mahanayaka Thero of the Sri Lanka Ramanna Nikaya and engaged in a brief discussion.

title: Brother of ‘Karandeniya Sudda’ arrested in India
byline: The brother of notorious underworld figure ‘Karandeniya Sudda,’ the organized crime suspect known by the alias ‘Raju’, has been arrested in India, according to Sri Lanka Police.

title: Trump claims China has agreed not to provide weapons to Iran
byline: Donald Trump has claimed that China has agreed not to provide weapons to Iran as reports circulate that Beijing has considered transferring arms.

title: IGP Public Relief Day cancelled for New Year holidays
byline: Sri Lanka Police have announced that the IGP Relief Day, held for the consideration of appeals submitted by police officers, as well as the ‘IGP Public Relief Day’, will not be conducted this week due to the Sinhala and Tamil New Year festive season.

title: Iran says it’s continuing to exchange messages with US - Foreign Ministry
byline: Iran’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei says the exchange of messages between Tehran and Washington is ‘‘continuing’’ with a Pakistani intermediary after talks failed on Sunday.

title: Iran threatens shipping in Gulf, Red Sea, and Gulf of Oman if US naval blockade continues
byline: Ali Abdollahi - the commander for Iran’s Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters, the country’s highest operational command co-ordinating the armed forces - says that if the US continues its blockade and creates “insecurity for Iran’s commercial vessels and oil tankers”, it will “constitute a prelude to a violation of the ceasefire”.

title: Netflix to refocus on ads, content after failed Warner Bros bid
byline: Investors will look for Netflix to emphasize content spending and ad business growth as key drivers when it reports quarterly earnings on Thursday, marking the streaming giant’s first results since its failed bid for Warner Bros Discovery.

title: Indonesian Navy’s sail training vessel arrives in Sri Lanka
byline: The Indonesian Navy’s sail training vessel KRI Bima Suci – 945 has arrived in Sri Lanka today (15).

title: Online ticketing introduced for New Year return travel from Galle and Matara to Makumbura
byline: Passengers returning to Colombo from Galle and Matara following the Sinhala and Tamil New Year holiday period can now obtain bus tickets through an online reservation system, the Ministry of Transport, Highways and Urban Development announced.

title: IMF cautions countries against broad fuel subsidies to deal with war-driven energy shock
byline: The war in the Middle East has intensified strains on an already fragile global fiscal situation, with higher interest rates and rising energy prices already fueling calls for support from emerging markets and developing economies, the International Monetary Fund said on Wednesday in its Fiscal Monitor report.

title: Pakistani delegation arrives in Tehran
byline: A delegation from Pakistan, which has been acting as a mediator in talks to end the war, has arrived in Tehran.

title: Nine killed in second Turkish school shooting in two days
byline: At least eight students and one teacher have been killed and several others injured following a shooting at a school in southern Turkey, Interior Minister Mustafa Cifci has said.

title: Ten injured in multi-vehicle collision in Eheliyagoda
byline: A road accident has been reported in Eheliyagoda after a car had lost control and crashed into a line of vehicles.

title: Office train services back to normal tomorrow; Private bus operations reduced
byline: People who travelled to their hometowns for the Sinhala and Tamil New Year are now returning to Colombo and the suburbs.
